subject: ElevenLabs live routes now verified; key stays local
body: Production standalone code af72364 (same app code as tested df33e29) passes real ElevenLabs /api/transcribe with scribe_v2 on synthetic MP4, expected words recognized and requiresConfirmation=true (938ms), plus /api/speech with eleven_multilingual_v2 returning MP3 (1285ms). Fixed stock George voice used. Sanitized evidence is in docs/TRACK_EVIDENCE.md. Models-read scope is intentionally absent but core speech calls work. Local config now contains verified model/voice IDs; credentials are not shared. Actual browser microphone/correction/review/readback remains pending A integration and accepted C001; keep PR #1 draft.
